root_cause.text: The `audio_validators` table entry for the UAC3 AC header descriptor in `sound/usb/validate.c` was incorrectly defined with the `UAC_VERSION_2` protocol version instead of `UAC_VERSION_3`, causing UAC3 devices to bypass header validation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `sound/usb/validate.c` corrects the validator entry from `FIXED(UAC_VERSION_2, UAC_HEADER, struct uac3_ac_header_descriptor)` to `FIXED(UAC_VERSION_3, UAC_HEADER, struct uac3_ac_header_descriptor)`, and the CVE description states that this mismatch "results in the validator never matching for actual UAC3 devices... causing their header descriptors to bypass validation entirely."
